post.caption: In 1947, Princess Elizabeth was about to marry Prince Philip, and the Nizam of Hyderabad sent her a wedding present. He told Cartier in London that she could choose it herself. She chose a diamond necklace that Cartier London had made in 1935. It sold in 1936, and Cartier bought it back a year later. It is set in platinum with about 300 diamonds, and a pear shaped diamond drop hangs at the center. She also chose a floral diamond tiara with removable brooches. In the 1950s, she wore the necklace for official portraits.
